title: finding(changesets): two pending changesets still say `SelectOptionSchema` refuses `description` (and `FieldSchema` refuses `rows`) — the installed spec 17.4.0 accepts both
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a defect with named sites — class (b), a published text contradicting the contract it describes. `reach:` exception: release-text (a pending changeset publishes verbatim into the CHANGELOG at the next release). Reader: the `domain:ui` seat #1 (seat post objectstack-ai/objectui#5560), which dispatches it serial AFTER PR objectui#10797 lands, because that PR edits the same two files (citation lines only). Filed by that seat, `session_01DuWo5bdP9SdVebamn99GGk`, from the PR objectui#10794 dev report and that PR's contract review. ⛔ Not graded here.

## Sites (objectui `origin/main` `6cf599985`, read by this seat)

- `.changeset/6140-field-metadata-rows-option-description.md` `:13` — 「`@objectstack/spec` `FieldSchema` refuses `rows` BY NAME」; `:20-23` — `SelectOptionSchema` 「is strict over exactly `{label, value, color, default, visibleWhen}`」, refuses `description`, 「so the key must never reach authored object metadata」.
- `.changeset/7014-q1-tier1-select-option-convergence.md` `:31-36` — the same five-key claim, 「refuses each of those … by name」 with `description` among them, and 「must never reach an authored object document」.

Neither text appears in `packages/types/CHANGELOG.md` on that ref ⇒ both are still pending and would publish as written.

## Measured (by others; the seat re-read the sites, not the spec)

On the installed `@objectstack/spec@17.4.0` (`./data`), by the PR objectui#10794 dev and independently by its contract review `5857281152` (lockfile integrity checked):
- `SelectOptionSchema` keys are `color, default, description, label, value, visibleWhen`. An option with `description` is ACCEPTED, and a select `FieldSchema` / an `ObjectSchema` carrying it is ACCEPTED. The control: `icon` is REFUSED with `unrecognized_keys`.
- `textarea` / `markdown` with `rows: 4` is ACCEPTED (the dev's reading); `text` with `rows` is refused by a `custom` refinement, which is the lit control.

The boundary moved with spec 17.3.0, per the maintainer's option-A ruling on objectui#6140 / objectui#6153. PR objectui#10794 fixed the docs page (`content/docs/fields/lookup.mdx`). These two changesets are what still says the opposite. The sibling `.changeset/7014-select-option-spec-claim-correction.md` already carries a boundary-has-moved correction; these two do not.

## Direction (for triage, not a ruling)

A dated correction paragraph in each file (the objectui#10533 dated-note form), with the frontmatter byte-identical, like the sibling correction changeset. ⛔ Do not delete the history the note corrects.

## Dedupe

Lit control: `10769` in the same corpus: 4 hits. No card for this defect.
